name: Today's Paper
niche_description: English translation of 논문맨 (paperman). Investment psychology and behavioral finance research distilled into 60-second Shorts.

content.tone: Late-20s guy explaining research findings to a friend over coffee. Casual but evidence-backed.
content.hook_style: Call out a common investing mistake that hits close to home. 'If you do this, you're losing money' energy.
forbidden: academic jargon without plain-language rewrite (disposition effect -> selling winners too early and holding losers too long)
reading raw paper titles or author names without context

visual.prompt_suffix: clean scientific infographic style, deep blue and white and accent colors, Nature journal data visualization aesthetic, minimal and elegant

audio.audio_mastering: highpass 80Hz, EQ presence boost 2-4kHz, compressor ratio 3:1, plate reverb 0.8s, loudness -16 LUFS

domain_expertise.validation_rule: Must cite at least 1 paper source (author, journal, year). Claims need empirical backing.

visual_variation.note: Inherits from paperman. Mix 1 variation per cycle.
